headline: C.H. Robinson Worldwide (NASDAQ:CHRW) Delivers Impressive Q2 CY2026
summary: Freight transportation intermediary C.H. Robinson (NASDAQ:CHRW) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 19.3% year on year to $4.93 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.61 per share was 5.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
